title: TaskDraftList
description: Schema for LLM-produced task drafts before skill assignment. Skills are assigned inline by the LLM after collecting operation and documentation profiles.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the overall user request, capturing its goal, scope, and constraints.

tasks.description: An ordered, uncapped list of atomic TaskDraft objects. Create one draft per independently completable and verifiable concern. No skills field — skills are assigned inline by the LLM.

TaskDraft.description: A single atomic task produced by the LLM during decomposition. Does NOT include skills — skills are assigned inline after collection.

taskId.description: Stable identity for this draft task.

purpose.description: Single sentence describing what this task accomplishes. Must be actionable and self-contained.

context.description: Task-specific context for the worker. Include the relevant user-request details, background information, and constraints. Do not add filler text.

filesToRead.description: Explicit list of file paths the worker must read before starting. Purposeful task-related discovery remains permitted under the worker contract.

filesToWrite.description: Explicit write boundary containing file paths or bounded path patterns the worker is authorized to create, modify, or delete.

executionInstructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for the worker. Each step is a discrete, verifiable action.

action.description: What to do in this step. Must be concrete and verifiable.

verification.description: Optional: how to verify this step succeeded.
Top-level verification checks the worker must run against their output before finishing.

expectedOutput.description: Precise description of the Deliverable payload this task produces.

verificationCoverage.description: Observable checks covering this draft task's result.

couplingRationale.description: Inspectable exception for multiple files that publish one tightly coupled result.

dependencies.description: Directed dependency edges to other draft taskId values.

antiPatternSignals.description: Compound-task signals considered while defining the draft boundary.

purposeOutputAlignment.description: Explicit assessment connecting the draft purpose to its expected output.
